original_prompt.prompt: As a project manager, I want to create a Jira ticket that accurately reflects the user's needs. Please help me expand the following input into a comprehensive Jira ticket that includes the title, description, priority, and any relevant tags. Return the necessary components in strict JSON format, ensuring that each field is clearly defined. ### Example Input: - User's need: [User's actual need goes here] ### Expected Output: ```json { "title": "[Title of the Jira ticket]", "description": "[Detailed description of the issue]", "priority": "[Priority level]", "tags": ["[tag1]", "[tag2]"] } ```

enhanced_prompt.prompt: As a project manager, I want to create a Jira ticket that accurately reflects the user's needs. Please help me expand the following input into a comprehensive Jira ticket. The ticket should include the following components: - Title: A concise title for the ticket - Description: A detailed description of the user's needs - Priority: The priority level (e.g., Low, Medium, High) - Tags: Relevant tags associated with the ticket Please return the necessary components in strict JSON format, ensuring that each field is clearly defined. ### Example Input: - User's need: [User's actual need goes here] ### Expected Output: { "title": "[Title of the Jira ticket]", "description": "[Detailed description of the issue]", "priority": "[Priority level]", "tags": ["[tag1]", "[tag2]"] }
